001package edu.cnm.deepdive.trailtrack.model.pojo;
002
003import androidx.room.Relation;
004import edu.cnm.deepdive.trailtrack.model.entity.Pin;
005import edu.cnm.deepdive.trailtrack.model.entity.Track;
006import java.util.List;
007
008/**
009 * Represents a specialized {@code Track} that includes a collection of associated {@code Pin} objects.
010 * This class extends the {@link Track} class to encompass additional functionality for managing related pins.
011 *
012 * Features:
013 * - Inherits all properties and methods from the {@link Track} class.
014 * - Introduces a one-to-many relationship between a {@code Track} and its {@code Pin} objects.
015 *
016 * Relationship:
017 * - Annotated with {@link Relation} to define a database relationship between the {@code Track}
018 *   and {@code Pin} entities. The relation is based on the "track_id" column present in both entities,
019 *   wherein each track may have multiple pins associated with it.
020 *
021 * Methods:
022 * - Provides getter and setter methods for accessing and modifying the list of associated {@code Pin} objects.
023 */
024public class TrackWithPins extends Track {
025
026  @Relation(parentColumn = "track_id", entityColumn = "track_id")
027  private List<Pin> pins;
028
029  public List<Pin> getPins() {
030    return pins;
031  }
032
033  public void setPins(List<Pin> pins) {
034    this.pins = pins;
035  }
036
037}
